resale_co.name: Resale/Rental Certificate (Resale Certificate of Occupancy)
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of New Providence Building Department (Department of Planning and Development)
resale_co.lead_time: Allow at least 10 business days before closing; the Borough recommends applying as soon as the contract is signed
requirements: Working smoke detector on each level (not attic or crawl space) and in the vicinity of each bedroom door
Carbon monoxide alarm installed and working
Hardwired interconnected smoke/CO systems installed with the house must stay in place and working
Proper covers on all switches, outlets and junction boxes
No extension or zip cords used as permanent wiring
Pressure relief discharge pipe on boilers and water heaters, ending about 6 to 8 inches off the floor
Gas piping strapped, shut-off valves near appliances, unused gas pipes capped; no aluminum gas piping
Pool fences and gates in place and working
House numbers at least 3 inches high and visible from the street
Clear sight triangle at corners (vegetation trimmed)
No sump pump, roof drain or other connections to the sanitary sewer
Sound roof; leaders discharge away from the foundation and not onto the neighbor's yard
All work has construction permits that are closed, and the use conforms to zoning

fees.label: Resale/Rental Certificate, 1 or 2 family detached, per unit (includes 1st reinspection)
Resale/Rental Certificate, multi-family dwellings, townhouses, condos, per unit
fees.quote: 2. Multi-family dwellings, townhouse, condos - $100.00 per unit

fees.label: Additional inspections after the first reinspection, each

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Resale/Rental Certificate (on the Building Department page or at Borough Hall, 360 Elkwood Avenue) and submit it with the fee; the fee must accompany the application, check payable to Borough of New Providence. Inspections are scheduled once payment is received. Call (908) 665-1098 with questions.
resale_co.contact_title: Construction Official, Building/Fire Subcode (Technical Assistant: Debbie Timko)

resale_co.notes: Fees are from the Borough's application form (undated, linked from the Building Department page in October 2026). Apartment buildings are $50.00 per unit. The form also covers rentals (Rental CO), where a lead-free or lead-safe certificate is required; that is a rental requirement only. No individual staff email is published; the Building Department uses an online contact form (egovlink).

requirements: Smoke detectors on every level (not crawl spaces or unfinished attics) and outside each sleeping area; basement detectors near the bottom of the stairs
Carbon monoxide alarms in every separate sleeping area per NFPA 720 and the manufacturer
Hardwired interconnected smoke/CO systems from original construction must remain in place and working

authorities.name: New Providence Fire Official (fire code enforcing agency, based in the Borough Building Department, 360 Elkwood Avenue)
authorities.how_to_apply: The Borough's Resale/Rental Certificate application includes the smoke and carbon monoxide alarm checks; apply through the Building Department at 360 Elkwood Avenue, (908) 665-1098. Whether a separate smoke/CO certificate or fee applies is not published.

fire_cert.notes: The state fire directory lists the fire official (Edward E Nasto) at the Building Department's address and phone (360 Elkwood Ave, (908) 665-1098), with an email at the older newprov.org domain (the Borough site is now newprov.us). The Borough site has no separate fire prevention page or smoke certificate form; the Resale/Rental Certificate application checks smoke and CO alarms. It is not confirmed whether that certificate also serves as the state Certificate of Smoke Alarm and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Compliance or whether a separate fire fee applies. The resale form does not mention a portable fire extinguisher or the secondary power source label.

other_items.label: Open permits and violations
other_items.detail: No certificate is issued until outstanding permits, violations and work done without permits are cleared.

other_items.label: Sump pump and roof drain connections
other_items.detail: Illegal sump pump, roof drain and other connections to the sanitary sewer must be removed.

open_questions: Does the Borough Resale/Rental Certificate also serve as the state smoke and CO alarm certificate, or is a separate fire certificate and fee needed?
Is Edward E Nasto still the fire official, and is enasto@newprov.org still a working address (the Borough now uses newprov.us)?
Does the Borough require the secondary power source label (P.L.2025, c.19) at resale?
